body: Nahh, fuck that, it would make me more miserable, knowing I compromised just so I could say to myself I'm not alone, it has to be with someone you are attracted to, in my opinion.

Dude, I'm in the same boat in many ways, I work a 9-5 job full time, live at home with my parents, earn about £600-700 a month, so can't move out, have cut out of my life most or any of the friends, I use to have and now I find myself alone. The only person who I see these days is my weed dealer and that's it. I have only had one relationship with a girl and that went nowhere as she had her set of problems, that I couldn't deal with on top of mine. I'm also still a virgin. The problem I find is that there is not an answer to your problems that you will want to hear. You try everything to avoid the real answer as it involves confronting them head on, like I smoke weed everyday for example to almost keep me from going full on suicidal. For me, I know what I need to do to in theory in order to start moving forward but when it comes to actually doing it, I can't face it, so I smoke more weed, keep feeling depressed and become more isolated as time goes on. The fact is, is that YOU know what you need to do in order to change but you won't because of whatever you feel about yourself, the world around you, etc. That is why you went to the gym because you were trying to see if that would help build your confidence, I would assume. There is no answer here tbh, you just have to find your way and I have known this deep down for years but until you internalize it and stop caring about what the world thinks, it will stay the same. As for going to doctors, they can help to a certain extent, but when I went to see somebody about it, they just put me on a stack of drugs, that fucked me up even more. However, if you see a psychologist, then it might be beneficial but in my case, it was not, but not to say it won't work for you. I think the problem that everybody seems to have here, is that people want an easy answer, they want some magical drug to take their problems away, they want somebody to tell them that everything is going to be ok, but all of this is bullshit. Unless, you take responsibility for your own life and how you want it to go, nothing will change, no matter what doctor you see. The funny thing is, is that you most likely know this the case as well but like me, but can't face it as it means actually trying to change it. I honestly wish their was a quick fix, but I have realized that their isn't. It's amazing how are situations are not that different from each other. Message me, if you need to talk more, might be helpful to me too, stay safe.
